status: Research and proposed experiments only. No private conversations read, no collection enabled, no training or runtime changes.
nonnegotiable_evaluation: Server capacity 262144; evaluate with at least 200000 occupied tokens, preferably about 260000 plus generation headroom. Match target/draft revisions, sampling, tree, power, clocks, and quantization.

measured_basis.finding: Acceptance varies strongly with workload while verification cost stays similar. These are synthetic results, not private-session measurements.

ranked_ideas.idea: Diagnose acceptance failures and calibrate candidate/tree selection
ranked_ideas.method: Record emitted tokens per round, round time, first rejection depth, candidate coverage and ranking errors. Sweep existing tree temperature and feasible node budgets on held-out long-context synthetic tasks before retraining. Current DFlash block caps the tree at seven draft nodes; setting a larger environment value alone cannot expand it.
ranked_ideas.success: Higher emitted tokens per second without a quality/distribution regression; judge the deployed seven-node tree, not just training proxy metrics.

ranked_ideas.idea: Targeted continued training of the C3 drafter
ranked_ideas.method: Use permitted low-acceptance segments plus adjacent synthetic tasks and representative easy replay examples. Capture teacher features from the actual frozen Marathon target with the relevant long prefix/state. Resume the unquantized C3 checkpoint or adapters if retained; do not use the Q4 GGUF as the preferred training master. Export and quantize once, then measure the deployed artifact.
ranked_ideas.success: Held-out whole-session tests at 200K-262K show a repeatable end-to-end decode improvement, including difficult segments, with no regressions on the original workload mix.

ranked_ideas.idea: Profile and optimize target verification kernels
ranked_ideas.method: Use Nsight on a free leased GPU to split attention/KV, quantized matrix operations, Gated DeltaNet, launch/synchronization costs. Built-in phase timing does not establish which target kernels dominate.
ranked_ideas.success: Lower target verification milliseconds at near-full context with matched output/quality checks.

ranked_ideas.idea: Selected KV reads during verification, only if profiling supports it
ranked_ideas.method: Treat as an approximate research branch. Preserve full-context retrieval tests and evaluate target-distribution/quality changes explicitly.
ranked_ideas.success: Attention is sufficiently costly and measured retrieval/quality tradeoffs are acceptable.

proposed_data_loop: Begin with content-free per-request/per-window telemetry and opaque identifiers, with authorized collection scope defined before deployment. Worker-global Prometheus totals alone do not identify exact failure segments.

Rank low-acceptance windows within comparable context lengths, output phases, sampling and hardware conditions. Exclude prefill, tools, cache restore, queued time and other slowdowns that drafter training cannot fix.
Inspect candidate coverage versus ranking/first-failure statistics. Prompt/output analysis can suggest task families, but the drafter itself need not become an analyst.

Create synthetic neighboring tasks covering the deficient structures. Label them using the frozen deployed target, including its emitted thinking/tool syntax when relevant; rejected draft tokens are not positive labels.

Replay with the original relevant long prefix or compatible saved state to obtain selected teacher hidden states. A short detached excerpt is not equivalent to a 262K-context sample. Keep captures bounded; long-prefix replay has compute cost.

Mix hard cases and representative cases; split by complete sessions/tasks before augmentation to avoid near-duplicate leakage. Resume a floating-point C3 checkpoint, train on a free GPU, then quantize once.

Evaluate the final Q4_K_M drafter on held-out 200K-262K contexts, actual sampling and seven-node tree. Include ordinary traffic and slow-tail tasks, not only the mined failures. Stage a rollback-capable candidate; do not auto-promote.
corrections_to_supplied_analysis: The broad adaptation loop is established; exact C3/3090/262K gains remain unmeasured.

EAGLE-3 simulates multi-step drafting during training; it is not accurately summarized as harvesting accepted live tokens and iteratively retraining on slow replies. Online Speculative Decoding is the closer precedent.
Baseten reports 20% median acceptance improvement in its deployments, not a guaranteed throughput gain here. No defensible single-digit gain forecast exists for C3 yet.

LK loss is a research candidate, not automatically a drop-in optimum for this custom tree verifier. SpecForge supports CE/LK/TV objectives and D-PACE weighting, but serving-tree acceptance must decide.
Low throughput is not always poor acceptance. Optimize emitted tokens per wall-clock round, not aggregate accepted/proposed fraction across different tree shapes.
Adaptive draft training leaves the target frozen; distribution preservation depends on correct verification, not on any claim that every generated sample stays byte-identical.
Offline capture is simpler to isolate but not necessarily cheaper than live feature collection; at 262K, recomputing teacher prefixes can dominate.

illustrative_math_not_forecast.meaning: 4 to 5 emitted tokens per round yields 25% more throughput at unchanged cost. Moving 80 to 150 tok/s would require nearly doubling emitted length, so it is a much stronger claim.

sources.supports: Online Speculative Decoding adapts draft models to observed queries through distillation; direct precedent for the overall feedback loop.
Production collection of live teacher hidden states for draft training; reported median acceptance improvement 20%. Does not validate this exact model, workload or hardware.
Domain-specific draft distillation and synthetic alignment data. In studied domains synthetic data achieved 80-93% of historical-query training performance; not a forecast for Marathon.
EAGLE-3 training-time test simulates multistep drafting and addresses feature-input distribution mismatch; distinct from live failure mining.
Acceptance-oriented objectives; applicability to the custom tree must be evaluated.
DFlash2 selected hidden-state capture, selector versus candidate-coverage diagnostics, objective options; training proxy metrics are not serving acceptance.
C3 is already specialized using synthetic tasks; card reports re-quantization problems after training from an already-quantized draft.
